title: GL-06 — NAT gateway then delete
stopChargesPanel: Delete NAT gateway, wait deleted, release EIP, then tear down VPC components.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on NAT gateway; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Create VPC and subnets
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.60.0.0/16 --query Vpc.VpcId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-06}]"`.
Run `$SubnetPub = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.60.1.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1a --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text`.
Run `$SubnetPriv = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.60.2.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1b --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text`.
Success: `$VpcId`, `$SubnetPub`, and `$SubnetPriv` are set.

steps.title: Internet gateway and route tables
bullets: Run `$IgwId = aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=internet-gateway,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-06}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId`.
Run `$PublicRouteTableId = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VpcId --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text`.
Run `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id $IgwId`.
Run `$RtAssocPub = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPub --query AssociationId --output text`.
Run `$PrivateRouteTableId = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VpcId --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text`.
Run `$RtAssocPriv = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PrivateRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPriv --query AssociationId --output text`.
Success: public subnet has an IGW route; private table exists.

steps.title: Allocate Elastic IP
bullets: Run `$AllocationId = aws ec2 allocate-address --domain vpc --query AllocationId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=elastic-ip,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-06}]"`.
Success: `$AllocationId` is set.

steps.title: Create NAT gateway
bullets: Run `$NatGatewayId = aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id $SubnetPub --allocation-id $AllocationId --query NatGateway.NatGatewayId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=natgateway,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-06}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-available --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId`.
Success: NAT State is available.

steps.title: Private default route
bullets: Run `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id $PrivateRouteTableId --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId`.
Success: private route table lists the NAT route.

steps.title: Delete NAT and release EIP
bullets: Run `aws ec2 delete-nat-gateway --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId`.
Run `aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-deleted --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId`.
Run `aws ec2 release-address --allocation-id $AllocationId`.
Clear `$NatGatewayId` and `$AllocationId` after success.
Success: no NAT or EIP remains for this lab.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: NAT/EIP if any remain, then route tables, subnets, IGW, VPC
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-06` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: if ($NatGatewayId) { aws ec2 delete-nat-gateway --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId; aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-deleted --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId }
if ($NatGatewayId) { aws ec2 delete-nat-gateway --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId; aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-deleted --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId }
if ($AlbArn) { aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-arn $AlbArn; aws elbv2 wait load-balancers-deleted --load-balancer-arns $AlbArn }

if ($AsgName) { aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --min-size 0 --max-size 0 --desired-capacity 0; aws autoscaling delete-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --force-delete }
if ($InstanceId) { aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId; aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId }
if ($IgwId -and $VpcId) { aws ec2 detach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId; aws ec2 delete-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-06 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-06 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-06. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Create one NAT gateway and a private subnet default route through it, verify, then delete NAT and release the Elastic IP same day.
